original: WPRPLACE National Park (Icelandic pronunciation: [ˈjœːkʏlsˌaurˌkljuːʏr̥]) is a former national park situated in the north of Iceland around the river Jökulsá á Fjöllum. It lies to the north of the Dettifoss waterfall. On 7 June [dated source], it became a part of the larger Vatnajökull National Park.
